# Gamedealwave - Knowledge Base

> Steam, Epic, GOG game deal tracker with historic low alerts.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- 80,000+ PC games tracked Steam, Epic, GOG
- Historic low alerts
- Wishlist tracking
- Bundle detection

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://gamedealwave.online/
